muscle_eze.name: Muscle Eze
muscle_eze.key: Per 3 capsules: 200 mg magnesium (citrate), 100 mg calcium (lactate), 50 mg L-theanine, 40 mg passion flower extract
muscle_eze.src: Supplement Facts: labels.json entry R884, NutriDyn sell sheet 'Muscle Eze SS ND433' Rev. 7/26 (Dropbox id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA6G6g): serving 3 capsules, 30 servings, Ca 100 mg (lactate), Mg 200 mg (citrate), L-theanine 50 mg, passion flower extract 40 mg; directions 'Adults take three capsules daily'; caution 'may cause drowsiness'. Size R884 90C from ND144 price list Rev. 10.1.26. URL from repo blasts/2026-09-22-muscle-guarding.html.

mag_calm_pro.name: Mag Calm Pro
mag_calm_pro.key: Per scoop: 200 mg magnesium (dimagnesium malate), 500 mg taurine, 2 g myo-inositol, 100 mg L-theanine (Suntheanine), 5 mg vitamin B6 (P5P)
mag_calm_pro.src: Supplement Facts: labels.json entry R2122, NutriDyn sell sheet 'Mag Calm Pro SS ND1075' Rev. 11/24 (Dropbox id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAryEw): about 1 scoop (4.13 g), about 60 servings; B6 (P5P) 5 mg, Mg (dimagnesium malate) 200 mg, myo-inositol 2 g, taurine 500 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg; directions 'Mix 1 scoop with 6 ounces of water 1-2 times daily'. Same amounts in the products DB (R2122, Metagenics chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size R2122 247.8 g from ND144 price list Rev. 10.1.26.

mag_k.name: Mag-K
